observed_ongoing_network_maintenance.titleEn: Urgent maintenance on all core routers
observed_ongoing_network_maintenance.descriptionEn:
We are currently carrying out urgent maintenance on all of our core routers. The routers are being serviced one after another. During this work, network redundancy is reduced globally. We do not expect any service interruptions, but you may experience increased latency.

This maintenance ensures the long-term security and stability of our infrastructure. We appreciate your understanding and thank you for your patience.

interpretation: Public provider maintenance notice is contextual evidence only; it does not attribute this incident or a specific failing carrier/hop.
